_catatan: Naskah explainer erp-software-house, diturunkan dari content/buklet.js (disetujui Farrez 9 Nov 2026).

gaya.id: Bacakan sebagai narator film dokumenter yang tenang, hangat, dan yakin, seperti video explainer sejarah. Tempo sedang, beri jeda panjang di antara paragraf.
gaya.en: Read as a calm, warm, confident documentary narrator, like a history explainer video. Medium pace, with a long pause between paragraphs.

teks.id: Software house tempat Farrez bekerja membuat sistem back-office untuk beberapa klien sekaligus.
teks.en: The software house Farrez works at builds back-office systems for several clients at once.

teks.id: Distribusi dan servis, asuransi kesehatan, sampai payroll perkebunan. Tiap klien punya aturan dan istilahnya sendiri.
teks.en: Distribution and service, health insurance, plantation payroll. Every client brings its own rules and vocabulary.

teks.id: Satu transaksi melewati banyak aturan validasi. Kalau satu aturan salah, staf di kantor klien yang pertama kena.
teks.en: A single transaction passes many validation rules. When one is wrong, the client's office staff feel it first.

teks.id: Staf membuka layar transaksi di web. API meneruskan permintaannya, logika berat berjalan di stored procedure SQL Server, lalu hasilnya kembali ke layar.
teks.en: Staff open a transaction screen on the web. An API passes the request on, heavy logic runs in SQL Server stored procedures, and the result comes back.

teks.id: Sistemnya dipakai kantor klien untuk pekerjaan harian.
teks.en: Client offices use these systems for daily work.
